events.proposition: Relevant locales/fincas and hotel/common infrastructure were separately disposed of to CAM; legal convalidation/effect is controlled by the later signed 24 October 2019 Auto.

Daniel recorded that he warned the AC that disregarding the unitary business and separately disposing of common/hotel elements damaged both the debt-payment operation and a future auction/bidding route.
events.source_quote: Le daba igual lo de la unidad de negocio. Le dije que asi se fastidiaba toda la operacion tanto de pago de la deuda como de una futura subasta.
events.limit: Daniel's own later sentence inferring an AC/CAM movement is an allegation/inference, not an established fact.

events.proposition: ONA sent a further addendum to the Sun Park rental/operating agreement, demonstrating continuing engagement after November 2018.

The signed Auto held in substance that the separate sale was incompatible with the unitary liquidation architecture/Audiencia interpretation, should not have proceeded separately while the appeal was pending, was not convalidated, and reopened the path for third-party improved offers.
